purpose: Full copy of contact_earnings taken 2026-08-04, before any commission-ledger work. This table is Rene's commission per contact (actual_earnings = earned at close, estimated_earnings = projected). cleanup_contact_financials() DELETES a row on every contact delete, so this data is destroyed by an ordinary CRM tidy-up and the ledger backfill depends on it existing.
why_now: Nothing has been lost yet - all 29 audited contact_earnings deletions carried actual_earnings = 0 - but 3 Closed contacts hold $42,531 of real commission with nothing protecting them.
no_redaction: Unlike snapshots/contact-orphans-20260804.json, nothing is withheld here: the table holds only contact_id (a UUID), two numbers and a timestamp. No borrower names, no account numbers. This is Rene's own business data.
